name: Frontiers
notes: Planetary Rework: physics-constrained world types (earth-like, ocean, arid, ice, metal-rich, mineral, gas giant, ice giant) with distinct Canvas visuals — landmasses on terrestrials, banding only on giants.
Moons on some worlds; rocky moons are landable and surveyable.
Spectrum Scanner: analyze bodies from long range to unlock a body dossier (gravity, atmosphere, composition, landable, moons), then approach for the detailed cartographics survey.
Gas and ice giants are labeled non-landable and cannot be entered.
Orbital groundwork fields (orbit radius/angle, mass, period) stored for a future orbital-mechanics update; bodies remain fixed in local space for 2.8.
